tools.name: search_archive
tools.description: Search the ISHOB archive (titles, keywords, authors). All words must match. Free.

query.description: Words to search for (all must match)

fulltext.description: Only resources with structured full text

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return

tools.name: list_topics
tools.description: List knowledge topics with live resource counts. Free.

tools.name: get_catalog_page
tools.description: Browse the catalog, 100 resources per page, optionally by topic. Free.

topic.description: Topic slug from list_topics, e.g. laser-calibration

tools.name: get_document
tools.description: Record metadata, abstract, license and attribution for one resource. Paid ($0.001, x402).

id.description: Resource id from search_archive / get_catalog_page, e.g. pmc-13364419

tools.name: get_fulltext
tools.description: Structured full text (sections) of one resource, with license. Paid ($0.01, x402).

id.description: Resource id from search_archive / get_catalog_page, e.g. pmc-13364419

tools.name: get_references
tools.description: Parsed reference list of one resource. Paid ($0.002, x402).

id.description: Resource id from search_archive / get_catalog_page, e.g. pmc-13364419

tools.name: extract_webpage
tools.description: Fetch a public web page live (robots.txt respected) and return clean Markdown. Not stored or redistributed. Paid ($0.001, x402).

tools.name: site_metadata
tools.description: Extract a page's title, meta tags, OpenGraph, Twitter card, canonical/icons/feeds and JSON-LD from the <head> only (no full DOM download, robots.txt respected, nothing stored). Paid ($0.0002, x402).

tools.name: get_dataset
tools.description: Static Knowledge Base: open, commercially reusable datasets (world cities, countries, ISHOB topics) by page, by id or by facet filter, with licence and attribution. Free catalogue: /v1/datasets. Paid ($0.0001, x402).

key.description: Dataset key from /v1/datasets, e.g. world-cities, countries, archive-topics

tools.name: weather_risk
tools.description: Current weather and hourly forecast (MET Norway, CC BY 4.0) for a lat/lon, plus decision flags: drone_safe, event_risk (low/moderate/high), rain_expected, frost_risk, high_wind — with the thresholds used. Heuristics, not aviation or safety advice. Paid ($0.001, x402).

tools.name: domain_intel
tools.description: Domain intelligence: registration via RDAP (registrar, created/expiry dates, status, nameservers, DNSSEC; unregistered = likely available), DNS (A/AAAA/NS/MX/SPF/DMARC, email and DNS providers) and the homepage tech stack (CDN, hosting, server, CMS, frameworks, analytics, payments) with evidence. Paid ($0.0004, x402).

tools.name: geocode
tools.description: Offline geocoding (GeoNames + DB-IP, CC BY 4.0): exactly one of ip (IPv4/IPv6 -> country/region/city/lat,lon), q (place name, e.g. 'Springfield, IL, US', optional country filter), postcode (+country), or lat+lon (reverse: nearest places). City/place level; no street addresses. Paid ($0.001, x402).

q.description: Place name; qualifiers after commas (region, country)

postcode.description: Postal code to look up; combine with country for precision

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return

tools.name: extract_tables
tools.description: Extract tables as structured JSON (rows, header, records keyed by column) from a public PDF (multi-column / ruled tables, up to 30 pages, 10 MB) or an HTML page (colspan/rowspan expanded). robots.txt respected; nothing stored. No OCR. Paid ($0.001, x402).

url.description: Public URL of a PDF or HTML page

tools.name: finance_snapshot
tools.description: Fundamentals and ratios for a US-listed company from its latest annual SEC filing (10-K/20-F, public domain): revenue, net income, EPS, cash flow, debt, equity; debt-to-equity, current/quick ratio, margins, ROE/ROA, growth. P/E and market cap are null (no licensed price feed); EPS and shares outstanding are included to compute them. Paid ($0.001, x402).

ticker.description: Ticker of an SEC-registered company, e.g. AAPL, MSFT, BRK-B

tools.name: screenshot
tools.description: Render a public web page in headless Chromium (Cloudflare Browser Rendering) and return a screenshot (PNG/JPEG/WebP, base64) for vision models: viewport up to 1920x1920 (default 1920x1080) or full page up to 8000 px. robots.txt respected; every page request is SSRF-guarded; nothing stored. Paid ($0.001, x402).

full_page.description: Capture the whole scrollable page instead of the visible viewport

wait_until.description: When to capture: after the load event or once the network is idle

delay_ms.description: Extra wait after loading, in milliseconds

tools.name: ping_status
tools.description: Uptime / API health check: is a URL up, HTTP status, response time, redirect chain, headers and security headers (edge), plus the TLS certificate (issuer, expiry date, days remaining, SAN, verification errors). A down target is a valid answer. Paid ($0.0002, x402).

method.description: HTTP method used for the check

check_ssl.description: Also inspect the TLS certificate (issuer, expiry, verification)

follow_redirects.description: Follow HTTP redirects to the final URL

tools.name: read_feed
tools.description: Read a published RSS 2.0 / RSS 1.0 / Atom / JSON Feed (blogs, news, podcasts, Reddit, Mastodon, YouTube channel feeds) as clean JSON items: title, link, ISO dates, author, plain-text summary/content, categories, enclosures. An HTML page URL is followed to its advertised feed. robots.txt respected; nothing stored; social networks are not scraped. Paid ($0.0003, x402).

url.description: Feed URL, or a page that advertises a feed

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return

tools.name: embed_text
tools.description: Text embeddings for RAG / semantic search: one string or up to 100 strings -> L2-normalised vectors with open BAAI models on Cloudflare GPUs: bge-small-en-v1.5 (384-d, English, default) or bge-m3 (1024-d, multilingual). Up to 24,000 characters per call. Paid ($0.0002, x402).

input.description: Text or list of texts (a single string is also accepted)

tools.name: site_speed
tools.description: Page speed & Core Web Vitals from a real headless-Chromium load (mobile or desktop): LCP, CLS, FCP, TTFB, total blocking time with good/needs-improvement/poor ratings, load timings, request count and page weight by resource type. Unthrottled lab run from Cloudflare's network (not Lighthouse, not field data). robots.txt respected. Paid ($0.001, x402).

device.description: Device to emulate: mobile or desktop

tools.name: render_document
tools.description: Render Markdown (tables, code, lists, headings) into a styled PDF (custom CSS, A4/Letter/Legal, page numbers), a Word DOCX or standalone HTML; returns a private download link valid for 24 hours. External resources are never fetched (inline data: images only). Paid ($0.001, x402).

markdown.description: Markdown source of the document (tables, lists, code, headings)

filename.description: File name for the download (extension added automatically)

tools.name: contract_abi
tools.description: Verified smart-contract ABI (+ optional Solidity/Vyper source) for Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, Optimism, Polygon and BNB Chain from the open Sourcify registry: compiler, deployment, read/write function and event signatures, and proxy resolution to the implementation ABI. Unverified contracts return 404 (not charged). Paid ($0.001, x402).

include_source.description: Include verified source files (up to 600k characters)

resolve_proxy.description: Also return the implementation ABI of a proxy

tools.name: token_audit
tools.description: Token safety & scam check for an ERC-20 (Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, Optimism, Polygon, BNB Chain) or SPL mint (Solana): honeypot simulation, buy/sell tax, mint / blacklist / pause / owner privileges, LP lock, holder concentration (Powered by GoPlus Security) plus our own on-chain checks (proxy slots, owner, verified source, mint/freeze authority, Token-2022 extensions). Returns severity-ranked flags and a risk level. Paid ($0.001, x402).

tools.name: swap_route
tools.description: Best DEX swap route and quote on Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, Optimism, Polygon or BNB Chain via the KyberSwap aggregator (400+ liquidity sources, split routes): output amount, slippage-protected minimum, USD value change, gas, hops. With `sender`, also an unsigned ready-to-sign transaction plus the ERC-20 allowance check. Quotes only; ISHOB never sends transactions. Paid ($0.001, x402).

amount.description: Amount of token_in in normal units, e.g. '1.5' (or use amount_raw)

amount_raw.description: Amount of token_in in base units (wei)

sender.description: Optional wallet address: returns an unsigned transaction + allowance check

tools.name: crypto_prices
tools.description: Live token prices computed from on-chain DEX pools (Uniswap V3, PancakeSwap V3, Orca Whirlpools) on Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, Optimism, Polygon, BNB Chain and Solana, with pool depth, confidence and 24h change; plus an Aave V3 yield screener (supply/borrow APY and market size per asset). No third-party price feed: every figure is derived from public chain state. Paid ($0.001, x402).

tokens.description: Comma-separated, max 10: symbols (ETH, BTC, SOL, BNB, POL, ARB, OP, USDC, USDT, DAI, LINK, UNI, AAVE) or chain:address (base:0x..., solana:<mint>)

yields_chain.description: Also return Aave V3 supply/borrow APY for every market on this chain

tools.name: gas_tracker
tools.description: Real-time gas fees and network health for Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, Optimism, Polygon, BNB Chain and Solana: slow / standard / fast EIP-1559 fees (base fee + priority tip, from the last 20 blocks), cost of a transfer / ERC-20 transfer / swap in native token and USD, congestion, base-fee trend, block time and latest-block age; Solana priority-fee percentiles and TPS. Paid ($0.0001, x402).

chains.description: Comma-separated subset of: ethereum, base, arbitrum, optimism, polygon, bsc, solana (default: all)

tools.name: wallet_portfolio
tools.description: Multi-chain wallet portfolio: native balances and token holdings with USD values and totals per chain. EVM addresses are checked on Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, Optimism, Polygon and BNB Chain (native + ~75 major tokens + up to 20 tokens you pass); Solana addresses list SOL and every SPL / Token-2022 holding. Prices come from on-chain DEX pools. Read-only public data. Paid ($0.001, x402).

address.description: EVM 0x address or Solana base58 address

chains.description: EVM only: comma-separated subset of ethereum, base, arbitrum, optimism, polygon, bsc (default all)

tokens.description: EVM only: up to 20 extra tokens as chain:0x... (comma-separated)

min_usd.description: Hide priced holdings worth less than this

tools.name: simulate_tx
tools.description: Simulate a transaction before signing it: what leaves and enters the wallet (native, ERC-20, NFTs, SPL) with USD values, approvals granted (unlimited / to non-contracts), revert reason, gas and fee, plus a risk level. EVM chains via eth_simulateV1 (raw call: from, to, data, value); Solana via simulateTransaction (base64 transaction, unsigned is fine). Nothing is broadcast. Paid ($0.0015, x402).

value.description: EVM: value in wei (decimal or 0x hex)

transaction.description: Solana: base64-encoded transaction (legacy or v0; signatures not required)

tools.name: token_report
tools.description: Token due diligence in one call: a 0-100 safety score and verdict (low-risk / caution / high-risk / avoid) with every deduction explained. Combines the token audit (honeypot, taxes, mint/blacklist/pause, LP lock, holders — Powered by GoPlus Security), a verified-contract scan for owner powers, price and real DEX liquidity, and live sell tests ($100 and $1,000 to USDC). Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, Optimism, Polygon, BNB Chain, Solana. Paid ($0.05, x402).

tools.name: token_verdict
tools.description: Should I touch this token? A fast plain-English verdict (low-risk / caution / high-risk / avoid) with a 0-100 score, the top 3 reasons, the good signals and the key facts (honeypot, taxes, liquidity, holders, owner). Rule-based, no AI: same token, same answer. Optional 1200x630 SVG share card. Powered by GoPlus Security plus on-chain checks and real DEX liquidity. Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, Optimism, Polygon, BNB Chain, Solana. Paid ($0.01, x402).

card.description: Also return card_svg, a 1200x630 SVG image of the verdict

tools.name: token_flows
tools.description: Who is buying and selling a token right now: every on-chain transfer in the last 1h / 6h / 24h split into DEX buys, sells and wallet transfers. Returns buy vs sell volume and net flow in USD, unique buyers and sellers, top net buyers and sellers, the largest trades (with tx hashes) and an organic-activity score with wash-trading signals (round-tripping, volume concentration, repeated bot-size trades). Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, Optimism, Polygon, BNB Chain. Paid ($0.01, x402).

tools.name: explain_transaction
tools.description: Explain any mined transaction in plain English: what happened (swap, transfer, approval, NFT buy/sell/mint, wrap, contract deploy, failed + revert reason), the sender's net token changes with USD values, every token and native-coin movement, approvals granted, the function called (named from the verified ABI or a signature database, with decoded arguments) and the fee. Rule-based, no AI. Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, Optimism, Polygon, BNB Chain. Paid ($0.005, x402).

tools.name: resolve_name
tools.description: Resolve ENS names and Basenames both ways. name -> Ethereum address, Base address and profile records (avatar, description, url, email, Twitter/X, GitHub, Discord, Telegram) and whether it is that address's primary name; address -> its primary ENS name and primary Basename, each verified to resolve back to the same address. Works for .eth, *.base.eth, subnames and offchain (CCIP-Read) names. Unknown name or address = 404, not charged. Paid ($0.001, x402).

name.description: ENS name or Basename, e.g. vitalik.eth or jesse.base.eth (ASCII). Use this or address

address.description: 0x address to find the primary name of. Use this or name

tools.name: wallet_report
tools.description: Wallet risk & activity report in one call — vet a counterparty before you transact: the address's own reputation (sanctions, phishing, theft, laundering, mixer... Powered by GoPlus Security), open token approvals with risky spenders, scam tokens held, and the full portfolio with USD values across Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, Optimism, Polygon and BNB Chain (or Solana: holdings only). Verdict: clean / caution / high-risk / flagged / incomplete, with every reason listed. Paid ($0.03, x402).

address.description: EVM 0x address or Solana base58 address

chains.description: EVM only: comma-separated subset of ethereum, base, arbitrum, optimism, polygon, bsc (default all)

tools.name: company_snapshot
tools.description: Company snapshot in one call for any SEC-registered company: fundamentals and ratios from the latest annual report (revenue, margins, growth, debt, cash flow, EPS), SEC profile (industry, exchange, state, fiscal year), recent filings (latest 10-K / 10-Q, 8-K events, insider-trading activity in 90 days) and the official website's health (uptime, TLS expiry, email security, registration). Sources: SEC EDGAR (public domain), Wikidata (CC0). Paid ($0.05, x402).

ticker.description: Ticker of an SEC-registered company, e.g. AAPL, MSFT, BRK-B

domain.description: Optional website to check instead of the one on record

tools.name: site_audit
tools.description: Full website audit in one call: an A-F grade with four 0-100 scores (performance, SEO, security, availability) and every issue listed with a fix. One real browser load gives Core Web Vitals, SEO of the rendered page (title, description, headings, canonical, alt text, Open Graph, JSON-LD) and an optional screenshot; plus uptime, HTTP→HTTPS redirect, TLS expiry, security headers, SPF/DMARC email security, domain registration, robots.txt and sitemap. robots.txt respected; nothing stored. Paid ($0.02, x402).

device.description: Device to emulate: mobile or desktop

tools.name: research_brief
tools.description: Research brief on any topic in one call: the best papers from ISHOB's open-licence archive, filled with a live search of 250M+ scholarly works, each with authors, year, venue, DOI and citations; abstracts only for openly licensed papers (CC0 / public domain / CC BY / CC BY-SA), metadata and link for the rest; plus a short AI synthesis citing the papers as [n]. Checked before payment: if nothing is found anywhere the answer is a free 404 'not_covered'. Paid ($0.05, x402).

max_papers.description: Maximum number of papers in the brief

year_from.description: Only papers published in or after this year

include_live.description: Fill with live results from open scholarly sources when the archive has fewer papers

tools.name: location_report
tools.description: Location risk report in one call: resolve a place name (or reverse-geocode lat/lon), then weather risk for the next hours (drone-safe, outdoor-event risk, wind, rain, frost, extremes), local time, today's sunrise / sunset / daylight, and country facts (region, population, GDP, income group). For logistics, travel, events and drone planning. Paid ($0.01, x402).

q.description: Place name, e.g. 'Lisbon' or 'Springfield, IL, US' (or use lat+lon)

tools.name: set_agent_alarm
tools.description: Schedule a signed webhook to wake an AI agent later: ISHOB POSTs your JSON payload to your https callback at deliver_at or after delay_seconds (60 s to 30 days ahead), retrying failed deliveries (1, 5, 15, 30, 60 min). Each delivery carries X-ISHOB-Signature (HMAC-SHA256 with the signing_secret returned once). Free status: GET /v1/alarm/{id}; free cancel: POST /v1/alarm/{id}/cancel. Charged only when the alarm is accepted. Paid ($0.001, x402).

delay_seconds.description: Deliver this many seconds from now (60 to 2592000). Use this or deliver_at

deliver_at.description: Or an absolute time: ISO-8601 with timezone (2026-10-15T14:00:00Z) or Unix seconds; 60 s to 30 days ahead

callback_url.description: Public https URL that receives the POST

payload.description: JSON object sent back on delivery (max 8192 bytes)

tools.name: generate_barcode
tools.description: Generate a barcode or QR code as SVG or PNG: QR, DataMatrix, PDF417, Code 128, Code 39, EAN-13, EAN-8, UPC-A, ISBN-13, ITF and GS1-128. EAN/UPC/ISBN check digits are computed (or verified, never silently replaced). QR and DataMatrix support colours, square/rounded/dot styles and (QR) a centre logo from an https URL. Every format is verified scannable. Returns SVG text or base64 PNG plus a data URI ready to embed in HTML, PDF or labels. Paid ($0.001, x402).

text.description: Data to encode (URL, text, digits for EAN/UPC/ISBN...)

scale.description: Size: pixels per module (2D) or bar-width step (1D); default 4 (SVG) / 8 (PNG)

ec.description: QR error correction level (H when a logo is used)

logo_url.description: QR only: https URL of a PNG/JPEG/WebP logo (max 200 KB) placed in the centre

include_text.description: Print the human-readable text under linear barcodes

height_mm.description: Bar height for linear barcodes, in mm

tools.name: lookup_product_code
tools.description: Look up a product barcode number: identify and validate EAN-13, EAN-8, UPC-A, UPC-E, GTIN-14, ISBN-13/10, ISSN and ISMN codes (wrong check digits are reported with the correct digit), convert between forms (GTIN-14, EAN-13, UPC-A, ISBN-10 <-> 13) and decode the GS1 prefix. Then fetch product data from open databases: name, brand, quantity, categories, image, labels, Nutri-Score (food, cosmetics, pet food via Open Food Facts) or title, authors, publisher and cover (books via Open Library). Paid ($0.001, x402).

code.description: Barcode number: 8/12/13/14 digits or ISBN-10 (spaces and hyphens ignored), e.g. 3017620422003

lookup.description: Also fetch product / book data from open databases (false = validate and convert only)

tools.name: read_barcode
tools.description: Read barcodes and QR codes from an image (URL or base64): QR, Micro QR, DataMatrix, Aztec, PDF417, MaxiCode, EAN-13/8, UPC-A/E, Code 128/39/93, Codabar, ITF and DataBar. Finds every code in the picture, even rotated, small or inverted (phone photos, receipts, labels, screenshots), and returns each one's text, format, position and meaning (URL, Wi-Fi network, vCard, e-mail, phone, location, crypto payment URI, product GTIN). No code found = not charged. Paid ($0.001, x402).

image_url.description: Public URL of the image (PNG, JPEG, WebP, GIF, BMP, TIFF; max 8 MB). Use this or image_base64

image_base64.description: The image as base64 (or a data: URI), max 8 MB. Use this or image_url

formats.description: Only look for these formats (default: all)

tools.name: search_specs
tools.description: Full-text search over abstracts and full texts, with extracted technical specifications (values, ranges, tolerances, units). Numeric constraints like "50 Nm" are matched. Paid ($0.001, x402).

query.description: Words and optional numeric constraints, e.g. 'torque sensor 50 Nm'

category.description: Result category: tech_specs (specification tables) or general

topic.description: Topic slug from list_topics, e.g. laser-calibration

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return

tools.name: query_specs
tools.description: Structured specification table filtered by quantity (e.g. accuracy, wavelength, range), unit family, unit and value range, with source document and license. Paid ($0.001, x402).

query.description: Optional words the source document must contain

quantity.description: e.g. accuracy, resolution, range, wavelength, torque, temperature

family.description: Unit family: length, pressure, torque, force, temperature, frequency, power, voltage, current, mass, volume, time, percent

unit.description: Exact unit, e.g. nm, MPa, N·m

min.description: Minimum value, in the requested unit

max.description: Maximum value, in the requested unit

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return
